innovations.name: AI Crop Doctor
innovations.description: Mobile application using deep learning to identify crop diseases from smartphone images with 95% accuracy in 12 regional languages.
innovations.impact: Helped 200,000+ farmers in Maharashtra detect crop diseases early, reducing crop losses by 30%.

innovations.name: SmartSoil Sensor Kit
innovations.description: Low-cost soil testing kit with IoT connectivity providing real-time nutrient analysis and fertilizer recommendations.
innovations.impact: Reduced fertilizer usage by 25% in pilot farms across Pune and Nashik districts.

innovations.name: AirPure Mask
innovations.description: N95-equivalent mask with built-in air quality indicator and replaceable filter designed for Mumbai's pollution levels.
innovations.impact: Sold 500,000 units across Maharashtra, providing affordable protection during high AQI days.

innovations.name: Solar Microgrid Controller
innovations.description: Intelligent controller for solar microgrids enabling efficient power distribution in off-grid rural Maharashtra villages.
innovations.impact: Powered 100+ villages in Maharashtra with reliable 24/7 electricity from solar microgrids.

innovations.name: WaterGen Atmospheric Water Harvester
innovations.description: Solar-powered atmospheric water generator producing 100 liters/day from humid air for water-scarce regions of Maharashtra.
innovations.impact: Provided clean drinking water to 50,000+ people in drought-affected Marathwada region.

innovations.name: TrafficSense AI
innovations.description: AI traffic management system using computer vision to optimize signal timing and reduce congestion in real-time.
innovations.impact: Reduced average commute time by 22% in pilot areas of Mumbai and Pune.

innovations.name: EduPlay STEM Kit
innovations.description: Hands-on STEM learning kit with Arduino-based experiments designed for Maharashtra's rural schools with limited infrastructure.
innovations.impact: Deployed in 500 schools across Maharashtra, improving STEM learning outcomes by 40%.

innovations.name: MicroFinance Mobile App
innovations.description: Mobile platform enabling women's self-help groups to manage microloans, savings, and financial literacy in Marathi.
innovations.impact: Connected 1,000+ SHGs in rural Maharashtra, facilitating ₹100 Cr in microfinance transactions.

innovations.name: MediTrack Wearable
innovations.description: Affordable health monitoring wearable tracking vital signs and automatically alerting emergency services for rural patients.
innovations.impact: Monitored 10,000+ chronic disease patients in rural Maharashtra, preventing 500+ emergencies.

innovations.name: CropDrone X
innovations.description: Autonomous agricultural drone with AI-based crop health assessment and precision spraying capability for 5-acre plots.
innovations.impact: Reduced pesticide usage by 40% and increased yield by 18% for 500 farmers in Nashik and Pune.

innovations.name: WasteSegregator Pro
innovations.description: Automated waste segregation machine using computer vision and robotic arms for municipal waste management.
innovations.impact: Improved waste segregation accuracy to 95% in pilot wards of Pune Municipal Corporation.

innovations.name: Blockchain Land Registry
innovations.description: Blockchain-based land record management system ensuring transparent and tamper-proof property transactions.
innovations.impact: Piloted in 2 Maharashtra districts, reducing property disputes by 60%.

innovations.name: SmartPipe Water Monitor
innovations.description: IoT sensor system for real-time monitoring of urban water pipeline health, detecting leaks and contamination.
innovations.impact: Deployed across 200 km of pipelines in Mumbai, reducing non-revenue water loss by 35%.

innovations.name: VernacularVoice AI
innovations.description: Natural language processing engine supporting 12 Indian languages for voice-based queries and content creation.
innovations.impact: Enabled voice-based internet access for 2 million users in Maharashtra who cannot read/write English.

innovations.name: AgriWeather Station
innovations.description: Solar-powered weather station network providing hyperlocal weather data to farmers via SMS in Marathi.
innovations.impact: Deployed 500 weather stations across Maharashtra, providing weather forecasts to 100,000+ farmers.
